signal: Pactum raised a $54M Series C in May 2025, launched its Requisition Alignment Agent embedded in SAP and Coupa in March 2026, and showcased with AstraZeneca at Coupa Inspire 2026.

email.body1:
Heidi, saw Pactum close a $54M Series C and ship the Requisition Alignment Agent into SAP and Coupa.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise procurement teams are in-market than your sellers can personally cover before the next motion ramps, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Pactum off your funding and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Heidi, quick follow-up for Pactum.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pactum needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Heidi, last bit of proof for Pactum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pactum's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Heidi, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise-sales motion? I will tailor it to Pactum either way.
